subject: nereid-origin
q: Who claimed Eden — and this one never gets answered.
detail:
The Last Offering was a syringe holding the preserved seed of her chosen one, THE ONLY PERSON TO EVER CLAIM HER IN RETURN, and one of her aliases is Ea, whispered reverently by her first love. That seed became LAST KISS, the antidote she took immediately before changing Atlas — the last person she ever transformed, who did not want it, and who she did it to because the Found Family was in danger and she made a call.

Some say there was a lover. Eden is more closed about her past THAN RAE IS, so the answer never comes. This question is filed permanently open by design. Note also that her prisoner record is full of names she fed her captors — Delphine Lilith Semiramis and Eden Raven Nereid are both aliases, and the Above Top Secret line in her own file is a decoy she planted.
